name: Escalayer
source:
A heroine of justice who fights against the monster army of the invading army, Dai-Lust.
An energy generating device called the "Doki Doki Dynamo (DDD)" is embedded in her body, and when she becomes excited, she generates powerful energy.

Her special moves include slicing through enemies with the blade belt she has wrapped around her,Sublimit Escalation, and more.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.alicesoft.com/escalayer/chara.html]official site[/url]]
